metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Apurv Bazari

plugins.name: onboard
plugins.description: Writes Claude tooling for your repo, a project .mcp.json included; offers plugins, installs only the ones you accept.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Desktop notifications on macOS and Linux when Claude finishes or needs you, with repo, branch and a cooldown.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Saves where a session left off and offers it at the next start. Nothing runs until you choose what to do.

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: Turns a session, plugin or codebase into one interactive HTML page that loads nothing from the network.

plugins.name: lens
plugins.description: Reviews Claude's changes against the spec and plan they followed and verifies each finding. Never edits code.
